headline: Brighton bring 5 straight wins; Liverpool remain slight favourites
summary: Brighton come to Anfield on five straight wins, with 17 goals scored in that run and third place in the table. Liverpool's home record is the question: Manchester City won 0-3 there this month, and Tuesday's 4-3 comeback against Villarreal left them five days between games, while Brighton have had 7. Even so, Liverpool are 45.3% favourites, rated 0.32 goals better — about a third of a goal. Brighton's 30.4% is a real chance, and the market expects 3 goals.
read: Brighton arrive at Anfield on a run of five straight wins, third in the table on 16 points with a goal difference of +18, while Liverpool have conceded 10 goals in their last five matches including a 0-3 home defeat to Manchester City.

facts.fact: Brighton have won their last five matches, scoring 17 goals and conceding 2.
facts.meaning: The visitors arrive at Anfield as the form team in this fixture, not as underdogs hanging on.

facts.fact: Brighton are third in the Premier League with 16 points from seven games and a goal difference of +18.
facts.meaning: They sit above Liverpool, who are fifth on 12 points from the same seven matches.

facts.fact: Liverpool lost 0-3 at home to Manchester City on 11 October, their only league defeat of the season.
facts.meaning: Anfield has already been taken apart once this season, so home advantage is not a guarantee here.

facts.fact: Liverpool came from 2-0 down to beat Villarreal 4-3 at Anfield in the Champions League on Tuesday, with Alexis Mac Allister scoring twice.
facts.meaning: They are scoring freely and fighting back, but they are also leaking three goals at home in Europe.

facts.fact: Brighton thrashed Crystal Palace 5-0 in the derby on Sunday, with Diego Gómez scoring from inside his own half.
facts.meaning: They go into an away trip to Anfield off their most emphatic result of the season.

facts.fact: Brighton have had seven days since their derby win; Liverpool played a Champions League match on Tuesday.
facts.meaning: The visitors should be the fresher side in the second half of a game expected to be open.

facts.fact: Liverpool are 45.3% to win, with Brighton at 30.4% and the draw at 24.4%.
facts.meaning: The home side are favourites, but this is not a one-sided price — more likely than not to avoid defeat, not to win comfortably.

facts.fact: The main goal line is 3.0, with over and under split evenly.
facts.meaning: Three goals is the expected total — a high bar that says the market expects an open game.

sources.fact: Liverpool came from 2-0 down to beat Villarreal 4-3 at Anfield in the Champions League, with Alexis Mac Allister scoring twice and Ronald Araújo and Florian Wirtz also on target.
Rio Ngumoha, 18, became the youngest Liverpool player to register a Champions League assist in the win over Villarreal.
After beating Villarreal, Liverpool's coach said Brighton are flying right now and that his side must stop conceding.
Virgil van Dijk called Rio Ngumoha's display against Villarreal a complete threat and said the teenager has learned from Mohamed Salah.
The referee and match officials for Liverpool v Brighton have been confirmed.
Brighton thrashed Crystal Palace 5-0 in the derby, with Diego Gómez scoring a wondergoal from 51 metres, the longest-distance Premier League goal since 2017.
Brighton have 16 points from seven matches this season, per Yahoo Sports.
The Athletic reports Brighton lead the Premier League in number of different goalscorers, ahead of a run of five straight away matches.
